movelist.name: Zen Headbutt
movelist.effect: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Flame Burst
movelist.effect: Any Trainers or Pokémon cardinally adjacent to the target lose 5 Hit Points.

movelist.name: Reversal
movelist.effect: For each Injury the user has, Reversal’s Damage Base is increased by +1.

movelist.name: Flame Charge
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Endure
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a damaging Move, you may use Endure as a Free Action. If the Move would bring Endure’s user down to 0 Hit Points or less, Endure’s user instead is set to 1 Hit Point.

abilities.name: Victory Star
abilities.effect: Any allied Pokémon in the encounter gain a +2 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.effect: The user may have up to three Food Buffs at once, use up to three Food Buffs per Scene, and may eat two refreshments per half hour.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Fire-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Fire-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.
